@@U02932@@
Timid little mouse, scared of my own shadow. God, and naive! I trusted them— those gray-bearded old fools and their eternal babble! They lied is what they did, lied to me, lied right out of their crusty ancient books! Teaching they called it! Telling me what they knew, they said! When what they knew they didn’t themselves believe! Wasting their lives and mine! But what's that? Someone back in that cell— sitting in the gloom. Coming closer, I can’t believe what I’m seeing. Still sitting there, just as I left him, still wrapped in that shaggy fleece. I thought at the time he was terribly wise; that, of course, was because I wasn’t. This time that won't be a problem. Let’s have at him then! Well, now, old gentleman (if your bald, bowed head is still unmoistened by 勒忒河’s turgid stream), you may recognize a former student, who meanwhile has outgrown the master’s rod. I find you just as I left you. As for myself, I return quite another man.

@@U02934@@
I’m glad the bell brought you. I had no small opinion of you back then. The caterpillar and chrysalis give fair warning of the beautiful butterfly to come. I remember your childish pleasure in your curly head and lace collar.
translation:
@@U02932@@
胆小的小老鼠，害怕自己的影子。天啊，天真！我信任他们——那些白胡子老傻瓜和他们永远的胡言乱语！他们撒谎就是他们所做的，对我撒谎，完全是从他们的古书上撒的谎！他们称之为教学！他们说，告诉我他们所知道的！当他们知道的时候，他们自己却不相信！浪费他们的生命和我的生命！但那是什么？有人回到那间牢房里——坐在黑暗中。走近了，我简直不敢相信自己所看到的。仍然坐在那里，就像我离开他一样，仍然裹着那件毛茸茸的羊毛。我当时觉得他非常聪明。当然，那是因为我不是。这次就不会有问题了。那我们就来对付他吧！好吧，现在，老先生（如果你低着的秃头还没有被勒忒河的湍急的溪水浸湿的话），你可能会认出一位以前的学生，而他此时已经不再适合老师的杖了。我找到你就像我离开你一样。至于我自己，我完全变了一个人。

@@U02934@@
我很高兴铃声把你带来。那时我对你的看法不小。毛毛虫和蛹发出了美丽蝴蝶即将到来的警告。我记得你的卷发头和蕾丝领子里孩子气的快乐。
